info.title: Week Notes API
info.description: HTTP API for the self-hosted Week Notes app. This describes the implemented contracts, not a redesigned API. Most mutations return HTTP 200; task mutations often return the entire live task array. PUT generally updates only supplied fields. Errors use existing JSON shapes such as {error} or {ok:false,error}, not RFC 7807. There is no built-in authentication: use only on a trusted host/network. The optional HttpOnly wn_ctx cookie selects the request context; without it the server uses the machine's active context. This cookie is not an authentication credential. GET /api/contexts refreshes it; POST /api/contexts/switch sets it and changes the machine default. Cookies are shared across browser tabs. Except for context management and API documentation, a server with no contexts redirects requests to /welcome. IDs and mention keys are distinct: CRUD uses IDs unless a parameter explicitly says key. Path segments must be URL-encoded. The general JSON body reader has no finite size limit; calendar import explicitly limits its request body to 1 MiB and decoded content to 512 KiB. UI pages and static assets are excluded, apart from the printable meeting-minutes export.

tags.description: Context settings, local Git operations and data migrations. Mutating these endpoints can affect files and Git remotes on the host.

get.summary: List tasks

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Include tombstoned tasks. Omit for live tasks.

post.summary: Create a task and return all live tasks
post.description: Defaults week to the current ISO week and author to the machine's @me mapping. Unless supplied explicitly, responsible and participants are inferred from text mentions. note is not accepted at creation; use the update endpoint.

put.summary: Update task fields and return all live tasks
put.description: Empty responsible clears it; empty or null dueDate, goalId, meetingSeriesId, meetingId and agendaItemId clear those links. null participants clears participants. A missing task leaves the list unchanged and still returns 200.

delete.summary: Tombstone a task and return all live tasks
delete.description: Removes results associated with this task. Missing IDs still return 200 and the current task list.

put.summary: Toggle completion and return all live tasks
put.description: An optional completion comment creates an oppgave-{id}.md sidecar note. A missing ID leaves the list unchanged.

get.summary: Get the derived origin and places mentioning a task
get.description: Read-only scan of the selected context's current notes and live domain content for {{?id}} and {{!id}} task markers. Each source appears once; the task's own fields, deleted records, bare IDs and unconverted create markers are excluded. Origin is independently derived from existing links in this order: meeting series, meeting, source note, goal. Neither backlinks nor origin are written to storage.

post.summary: Append a timestamped comment and return all live tasks
post.description: Adds to a separate append-only comment history without changing completion or task notes. The server assigns the comment ID and UTC creation timestamp. Comments can be added to open or completed tasks; missing or tombstoned tasks return 404.

text.description: Markdown comment; whitespace-only text is rejected.

post.summary: Set completion and update the linked note marker
post.description: Defaults done to true. Replaces {{?id}} with {{!id}}, or the reverse, in the linked source note. noteUpdated reports whether that replacement was written.

post.summary: Merge a source task into a target task
post.description: Appends source text/note to the target note, preserves both comment histories in timestamp order, removes the source task and its results, and returns live tasks.

post.summary: Reorder the global live task list
post.description: Listed IDs are placed first; unlisted tasks keep their relative order afterward. This is not the strict series-scoped permutation endpoint.

get.summary: List meetings by date and start time

parameters.name: upcoming
parameters.description: Filter to today through N days from today; a non-numeric value uses 7.

parameters.name: allContexts
parameters.description: 1 includes all contexts with _ctx metadata; requires crossContextCalendar.enabled.

post.summary: Create a meeting or planned series occurrence
post.description: Requires date and either title or seriesId. Series occurrences inherit defaults and snapshot all queued agenda items. For standalone meetings with start but no end, durationMinutes or the context default derives end. End must be after start, including endDate for multi-day meetings.

get.summary: Get a meeting

put.summary: Update a meeting or open series occurrence
put.description: Closed series occurrences are read-only until reopened. Updating attendees affects only this meeting, not series defaults.

delete.summary: Delete a meeting and unlink task meetingId references

post.summary: Start a planned series occurrence
post.description: Sets status to in-progress. Closed occurrences must be reopened; standalone meetings are rejected.

post.summary: Close a series occurrence
post.description: Automatically defers agenda entries without an outcome and synchronizes outcomes to the series queue.

post.summary: Reopen a closed series occurrence
Add an agenda item to an open occurrence and its series

put.summary: Update an occurrence agenda entry
put.description: itemId is the entry's agendaItemId. Outcome edits synchronize only this entry to the series. null or empty outcome clears it.

post.summary: Record a decision in an open series occurrence

agendaItemId.description: Must identify an agenda entry in this occurrence.

put.summary: Change a decision's agenda link, not its text

agendaItemId.description: An agendaItemId in this occurrence; null or empty string removes the link.

delete.summary: Remove a decision from an open series occurrence

post.summary: Preview an ICS/VCS calendar import without saving
post.description: UTF-8 calendar content, maximum 512 KiB and 500 events. Requires an IANA local timeZone. Recurrences are not expanded; recurring reports the number of RRULE events. duplicate marks already-known UIDs and repeated UIDs in this file.

post.summary: Import ICS/VCS meetings into the selected context
post.description: Validates the whole calendar before writing, skips known UIDs, and does not expand recurrences. Same limits as preview.

get.summary: List meeting types for the selected context

put.summary: Replace meeting types for the selected context
put.description: Entries without labels are dropped; absent/duplicate keys are generated. Invalid mins becomes 60.

get.summary: Get printable HTML meeting minutes
get.description: HTML suitable for printing or saving as PDF in a browser, not a PDF binary. Open occurrences are marked as drafts.

get.summary: List series with occurrence and queue rollups

post.summary: Create an active meeting series
post.description: Starts with an empty agenda. defaultAttendees falls back to mentions in description; defaultDurationMins defaults to 60.

get.summary: Get a series with rollups

put.summary: Update series fields or archive/unarchive a series

delete.summary: Delete a series and unlink occurrences and follow-up tasks
delete.description: Keeps meetings and tasks; removes their series links.

post.summary: Append a queued agenda item

put.summary: Edit an agenda item title or queue state
put.description: Does not rewrite existing occurrence snapshots.

delete.summary: Remove a series agenda item without rewriting snapshots

post.summary: Save manual order of every queued agenda item
post.description: ids must be an exact unique permutation of all currently queued items. Stale, duplicate, foreign or nonqueued IDs return 400 without writing. Resolved/cancelled slots and existing occurrence snapshots remain unchanged.

post.summary: Save manual order of every open series follow-up task
post.description: ids must contain every nondeleted open task with this meetingSeriesId exactly once. Saves series.taskOrder; global task order and task records are unchanged.

List weeks with notes, results or completed tasks
Get week-section metadata and note cards

post.summary: Save, append or autosave Markdown
post.description: Explicit save requires folder, file and content. createNew deduplicates filenames; append joins content. autosave writes a recovery file instead of the note; autosave+draft only requires content and optionally meta. commit opts into a best-effort context-wide Git commit. Close markers can complete tasks; entity creation from inline markers is the editor's responsibility before calling this endpoint.

Id.name: id
Id.description: Stable record ID (context IDs are directory slugs).

SearchQuery.name: q
SearchQuery.description: Blank or omitted queries return an empty array.

ContextCookie.description: wn_ctx=<context>; Path=/; Max-Age=31536000; SameSite=Lax; HttpOnly. Browsers manage this cookie automatically.

content.description: UTF-8 VCALENDAR text, up to 512 KiB.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for interpreting/displaying events.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input or operation. Legacy handlers can omit error and/or Content-Type. Context/remote conflicts may return needsConfirm:true.

NotFound.description: Record not found. Some legacy handlers return only {ok:false} and omit Content-Type.

Forbidden.description: Operation forbidden (for example cross-context calendar disabled)

Tasks.description: Entire live task array (GET with all may include deleted tasks)

SeriesMutation.description: Updated series; create returns the stored series without rollups

AgendaMutation.description: Agenda item and updated series with rollups

GitOperation.description: Git result; committed indicates whether a commit was needed

Removed.description: Whether a recovery file was removed

Error.description: Existing error envelope; fields vary by handler.

DueDate.description: Date or local date/time with a space separator; not an RFC 3339 timestamp.

id.description: Source record ID, entity key or week/file note path.

label.description: Plain-text display label; HTML must be escaped by consumers.

href.description: Local source URL, or null when a linked meeting no longer exists.

type.description: Origin group, present on a derived origin.

comments.description: Separate timestamped comment history; absent on older tasks.

start.description: HH:MM or empty for all-day/unscheduled time.

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD for multi-day meetings; empty clears on update.

joinUrl.description: Validated Teams meeting URL when present.

lat.description: Numeric strings accepted; invalid/empty values become null.

workHours.description: Monday through Sunday; null means no work band.

created.description: Timestamp or empty for legacy notes.
